holds.ULT>HOLD.cost.note: consideration US$100,000 (nominal price of US$1 per share, pdf 176); amounts in this case are in RMB and this case does not sell that company, so it is not converted

flows.up1.foreign_taxed.quote: a 10% withholding tax will be levied on the immediate holding companies established outside the PRC when their PRC subsidiaries declare dividends out of their profits earned after January 1, 2008.
flows.up1.foreign_taxed.formula: the Mainland levies withholding tax on dividends paid to a foreign direct holding company

flows.up1.foreign_headline_rate.quote: The Company’s subsidiaries in the PRC are subject to PRC CIT which is calculated based on the applicable tax rate of 25% on the assessable profits of the subsidiaries

flows.up1.deductible_at_payer.formula: a dividend is a distribution of after-tax profit, not deductible by the payer (Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 10(1))

flows.up2.foreign_headline_rate.quote: The Group’s subsidiary in Singapore is subject to Singapore CIT which is calculated based on the applicable tax rate of 17% on the assessable profits of the subsidiaries

flows.up2.deductible_at_payer.formula: a dividend is distributed out of after-tax profit, and s 14 of the Singapore Income Tax Act allows only outgoings incurred in producing taxable income — not deductible by the payer

present.HOLD.quote: Immediately following completion of these share transfers, Carote Group became the sole shareholder of Zhejiang Carote.
present.HOLD.formula: Hong Kong Carote Group holds Zhejiang Carote directly, with no intermediate holding company in between; Singapore Carote (Singapore) Management is likewise its wholly owned subsidiary and does not hold Zhejiang Carote

present.financing.quote: In August 2023, Carote Group purchased 100% equity interests in Zhejiang Carote from the Controlling Shareholders, the companies controlled by Controlling Shareholders and Denk Trade with a consideration of RMB67,731,000
present.financing.formula: equity acquired for cash (equity); no shareholder loan disclosed

present.payment.basis: whether the dividend is paid across years is not disclosed; payment in the same year is taken

event.on.basis: synthetic: 2026-06-30 (the prospectus period is 2021 to Q1 2024; no dividend to the Hong Kong company is disclosed)

event.dividend.quote: Pursuant to the resolution of the shareholder’s meeting of Zhejiang Carote held on December 3, 2022, dividends of RMB50,000,000 were approved to be paid to its then shareholders of the Zhejiang Carote.
event.dividend.basis: the dividend to the Hong Kong company is not disclosed (the directors say they do not expect a distribution, pdf 550); the RMB50,000,000 Zhejiang Carote declared to its then shareholders in 2022 is taken as the order of magnitude of one dividend

event.onward.basis: the intermediate company passes all the dividends it receives on to the Hong Kong parent

notes: Source: Carote Ltd (2549.HK, incorporated in the Cayman Islands) prospectus of 2024-09-23 (cases/sources/K3-carote-2024/source.pdf). K3 semi-synthetic: structure, ratios, dates and tax rates come from the prospectus; the dividend amount and date are synthetic values (see provenance).

Only the part within the three jurisdictions is taken: ULT is Carote Group (Hong Kong investment holding, incorporated 2023-03-07), OP is Zhejiang Carote (the main Mainland operating company, high-tech enterprise status 2022–2024, renewal for 2026 not disclosed), HOLD is Carote (Singapore) Management (Singapore, wholly owned by Carote Group since 2024-01-23, currently not holding Zhejiang Carote). The Cayman listed company and the BVI shareholders are not in this case.

The red-chip reorganisation itself (on 2023-08-29 seven shareholders transferred 100% of Zhejiang Carote to Carote Group for cash consideration of RMB68,000,000 or RMB67,731,000) had individuals, a Mainland company and partnerships as sellers, outside the scope of v1 (companies only), and is background only; this case tests the post-reorganisation Hong Kong–Mainland chain and the candidate of inserting a Singapore intermediate company.

Not disclosed: the Hong Kong company's economic substance, whether the dividend is received in Hong Kong, tax residence certificates, the facts needed for the beneficial-owner determination — left for the program to ask. Amounts are in RMB.
